("BEACN" or the "Company") announces its Q3 financial statements and accompanying MD&A have been filed. In the nine months ended September 30, 2026, BEACN realized a 37% decrease in revenue and a 33% decrease in gross profits when compared to the same period last year. The decrease in revenue was due to lack of inventory supply, and disruption in EU Amazon sales. Gross margin increased to 45% in Q1 to Q3 2026 (2025 - 42%) due to channel mix and price increases.

"Restoring sales rates from inventory stock outs is an ongoing effort and delays in bringing BEACN Headset continued to be a challenge in the last quarter. We're excited to have BEACN Headset shipping in US and Canada as of November," says BEACN CEO, Kevin Alexander.
Further information is available from the Company's financial statements for the period ending on June 30, 2026, on SEDAR at www.sedar.com.

, a Victoria BC based consumer electronics company, develops innovative audio equipment, peripherals and technology for gamers, live streamers, and content creators. BEACN is committed to delivering premium products that enable everyone to produce studio-quality content. BEACN's award-winning product ecosystem includes BEACN Mic, BEACN Studio, BEACN Mix and BEACN Mix Create. BEACN is listed on the TSXV under the symbol BECN.
